orderId.description: Human-readable order number shown on the confirmation screen (checkout.html makeOrderId). Unique index.

userId.description: Reference to users._id, or null for a guest checkout.

customer.description: Shipping details as typed into the checkout form. Embedded rather than referenced: an order must keep the address it shipped to even if the account later changes.

state.description: Two-letter state code; the form upper-cases it before saving.

zip.description: A string, not a number: ZIP codes have leading zeros.

items.description: A snapshot of the cart at checkout. Prices are copied in, not looked up, so a later price change never rewrites an old order.

name.description: Product name as it was when ordered.

unitPrice.description: Price actually charged per unit, in US dollars (the sale price when on sale).

qty.description: Whole units only. Matches MAX_QTY in app.js.

totals.description: Stored as calculated, so the order shows the same figures the customer agreed to (app.js cartTotals).

shipping.description: 0 when the subtotal reaches FREE_SHIPPING_MIN, otherwise SHIPPING_FEE.

amountCents.description: totals.total in whole cents. Integer cents are what Square's CreatePayment expects, and they avoid floating-point drift on the amount that gets charged.

status.description: Orders start at pending_payment; the payment step moves them on.

createdAt.description: A real BSON date. The browser currently writes an ISO string, so the API must convert it on insert: see SCHEMA.md.
